title: A2VM dispatch rules of a tenant
description: dispatch.yaml of a tenant project (pillar 4, LLD dispatch §4): the tools the decisions go to and the rules of what leaves. No credential: they are CI/CD variables.

mode.description: dry-run (default): proposed and logged, nothing sent; live: sent

automatic.description: what leaves after each run by itself (default act)

organization.description: name of the iTop organisation of the tickets

caller.description: name of the iTop Person the tickets come from

team.description: optional: name of the iTop Team the tickets are assigned to

due_field.description: Field of the ticket (an extension's date field) that receives the due date A2VM computed, the client's SLA else BOD 26-04; written on create and whenever it changes (v0.22.2). Unset: not pushed.

priorities.description: optional (v0.21.0): priority of the client's SLA -> impact and urgency of iTop (impact 1 a department, 2 a service, 3 a person; urgency 1 critical .. 4 low); a priority not listed, or a decision without one, takes those of its level
